supporting_observations.claim: The account was created at 13:46:51 UTC, later than the alert's approximate 13:42 time. The creator recorded by the domain controller was tess.hart.
The name guest.rwong matches the stated temporary-account naming convention, and the account was added to the Volunteers group, consistent with the stated help-desk procedure.
The account-creation event's subject logon ID matches a successful network logon for tess.hart from WS-THART-01 to DC-ORC-01 shortly beforehand.

Before the account was created, tess.hart launched Remote Desktop to DC-ORC-01 and successfully established a remote-interactive logon there. This is inconsistent with the stated practice that remote administration is only done from WS-SBYRNE-01, but the records do not establish that this RDP session performed the account creation.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show the account creation and a Volunteers-group addition, but do not establish the account's complete group memberships or effective privileges.
The supplied records do not show the process or tool that performed the account creation, or the actions taken within the RDP session.
No help-desk request, approval, or other authorization record for guest.rwong was provided.
claims_not_established: Whether guest.rwong was requested and authorized for a legitimate temporary purpose.
Whether guest.rwong received any other group memberships or privileges beyond the Volunteers addition shown.
Whether the DC RDP session was authorized or was used to create the account.
Whether the account was used after creation.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain the help-desk ticket or approval associated with guest.rwong and verify the intended owner, purpose, and duration.
Review the account's complete group memberships, privilege assignments, and subsequent sign-in and activity records.
Collect DC process and directory-service telemetry around the creation event to identify the tool and session that performed it.
Verify whether tess.hart's RDP access to DC-ORC-01 was authorized and what occurred in that session.
unrelated_findings: tess.hart also launched Remote Desktop to FILE-ORC-01 and established a remote-interactive logon there; review separately because this does not establish whether the alerted account creation was malicious. (T268-00068, T268-00072, T268-00073)
A proxy record shows a connection from WS-THART-01 to ec2.ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com; the purpose is not established and it is separate from the account-creation evidence. (T268-00055)
